description: Agent mode: gives your answer to the model request a run waits for, then the run continues until it needs the next answer, an approval or finishes. When the request has a JSON schema, the answer must be one JSON value matching it (no prose, no code fences); DevFlow validates it and asks again when it does not match. Your answer is model output: DevFlow checks it like any model's, and every approval stays with the developer. Runs `devflow agent answer <run> --request <id> --text <answer> --json`.

answer.description: The answer: JSON when the request has a schema, else text.

requestId.description: The requestId of the request, from devflow_agent_request or agentRequest.

run.description: Run id, as returned by devflow_plan, devflow_analyze or devflow_status.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_agent_respond
title: Answer the model request a run waits for (agent mode)
